decisive_items: Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
Mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE
directed an online-bought handheld high-intensity LED light at her right eye multiple times at very short distance with flash mode
response.rationale: Phototoxic maculopathy is the specific clinical diagnosis supported by acute high-intensity LED exposure and characteristic outer retinal OCT changes with subsequent restoration. Solar retinopathy is not applicable because the exposure was LED, not solar, and photoreceptor damage is a nonspecific tissue effect rather than the full diagnosis.

rejected.why: Solar retinopathy requires sun exposure; the light source was a handheld LED, so the 'solar' qualifier is unsupported despite similar phototoxic OCT findings.
Photoreceptor damage describes the observed tissue injury but is not the specific clinical diagnosis; phototoxic maculopathy better captures the etiology and syndrome.
